file_frame.palette: unique pastel color per file type; M3U8 blue and TS purple retained
file_frame.label_rule: Segoe UI Semibold, 8.5px font, default 1px character gaps at 24px, reduce gaps only to fit. Labels and circles share center x=12; baseline y=17.5. Long file types use short display labels. Fixed square canvas; no individual letter is compressed. Special new reuses file-new.svg. Frame gaps add 2px padding. Complete pure vector SVGs drive all PNG sizes.
file_frame.overlap_rule: If actual label bounds meet either side of the frame, open matching gaps on both sides; otherwise keep both sides complete. Independent of label length.
